description: This file provides low-level primitives for making Netlink calls, including socket management, message serialization/deserialization, and handling of netlink attributes and messages in Go.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error, used in errDumpInterrupted.

methods.name: Is
methods.description: Checks if the error is unix.EINTR, used in errDumpInterrupted.

methods.name: GetIPFamily
methods.description: Determines the family type (IPv4 or IPv6) of a net.IP.

methods.name: NativeEndian
methods.description: Detects the system's native byte order (endianness).

methods.name: Swap16
methods.description: Byte swaps a 16-bit unsigned integer if system is not big-endian.

methods.name: Swap32
methods.description: Byte swaps a 32-bit unsigned integer if system is not big-endian.

methods.name: NewCnMsg
methods.description: Creates a new CnMsg with specified index, value, and operation.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes CnMsgOp into a byte slice.

methods.name: DeserializeCnMsgOp
methods.description: Deserializes a byte slice into a CnMsgOp.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the length of CnMsgOp.

methods.name: NewIfInfomsg
methods.description: Creates a new IfInfomsg with specified family.

methods.name: DeserializeIfInfomsg
methods.description: Deserializes a byte slice into an IfInfomsg.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes IfInfomsg into a byte slice.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the size of IfInfomsg.

methods.name: EncapType
methods.description: Returns a string description of the link type based on msg.Type.

methods.name: NewRtAttr
methods.description: Creates a new RtAttr with specified type and data.

methods.name: AddRtAttr
methods.description: Adds a new RtAttr as a child to the parent RtAttr.

methods.name: AddChild
methods.description: Adds an existing NetlinkRequestData as a child to RtAttr.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Calculates the total length of RtAttr including children.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes RtAttr and its children into a byte slice.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the NetlinkRequest and returns list of messages or error.

methods.name: ExecuteIter
methods.description: Executes the request and calls a callback for each message.

methods.name: NewNetlinkRequest
methods.description: Creates a new NetlinkRequest with specified protocol and flags.

methods.name: getNetlinkSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a new NetlinkSocket for a given protocol.

methods.name: GetNetlinkSocketAt
methods.description: Opens a netlink socket in a specific network namespace.

methods.name: executeInNetns
methods.description: Executes code in a specified network namespace, restoring afterwards.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Creates and binds a netlink socket subscribed to groups.

methods.name: SubscribeAt
methods.description: Creates a socket in a specific namespace and subscribes to groups.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the netlink socket.

methods.name: GetFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the socket.

methods.name: GetTimeouts
methods.description: Returns current send and receive timeouts.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a NetlinkRequest through the socket.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives messages from the socket, returning parsed netlink messages.

methods.name: SetSendTimeout
methods.description: Sets the send timeout for the socket.

methods.name: SetReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Sets the receive timeout for the socket.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for the socket.

methods.name: SetExtAck
methods.description: Enables or disables extended acknowledgment messages.

methods.name: GetPid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID associated with the socket.

methods.name: ZeroTerminated
methods.description: Converts a string to a null-terminated byte slice.

methods.name: NonZeroTerminated
methods.description: Converts a string to a byte slice without null termination.

methods.name: BytesToString
methods.description: Converts a null-terminated byte slice to a string.

methods.name: Uint8Attr
methods.description: Creates a byte slice from a uint8 value.

methods.name: Uint16Attr
methods.description: Creates a byte slice from a uint16 value in native byte order.

methods.name: BEUint16Attr
methods.description: Creates a byte slice from a uint16 value in big-endian order.

methods.name: Uint32Attr
methods.description: Creates a byte slice from a uint32 value in native byte order.

methods.name: BEUint32Attr
methods.description: Creates a byte slice from a uint32 value in big-endian order.

methods.name: Uint64Attr
methods.description: Creates a byte slice from a uint64 value in native byte order.

methods.name: BEUint64Attr
methods.description: Creates a byte slice from a uint64 value in big-endian order.

methods.name: ParseRouteAttr
methods.description: Parses byte slice into a list of route attributes.

methods.name: ParseRouteAttrAsMap
methods.description: Parses byte slice into a map of route attributes by type.

methods.name: netlinkRouteAttrAndValue
methods.description: Extracts a route attribute and its value from byte slice.

methods.name: SocketHandle
methods.description: Holds a netlink socket and sequence counter for a family.
